"""Numeric boundaries: label column order, u32 exhaustion, per-request totals."""
import json, sys, time
sys.path[:0] = ['/workspace/project', '/workspace/tmp/dev', '/opt/emicro-deps']
from ebpf.helper import Agent
from ebpf.create_dfa import create

LIM = {'images': 16, 'cells': 262144, 'units': 1024, 'contexts': 32768,
       'connections': 4096, 'packets': 32768, 'files': 8192}
U32 = 4294967295
DENY = U32
fails = 0


def check(name, got, want):
    global fails
    if got != want:
        fails += 1
        print('FAIL %-30s got=%s want=%s' % (name, json.dumps(got, separators=(',', ':'))[:200],
                                             json.dumps(want, separators=(',', ':'))[:200]))
    else:
        print('ok   %s' % name)


OK = {'ok': True}
RJ = {'error': 'rejected'}

# ------------------------------------------------- columns follow label order
registry = [{'name': 'E', 'label': 40}, {'name': 'A', 'label': 7}, {'name': 'Z', 'label': 3},
            {'name': 'M', 'label': 4294967294}, {'name': 'B', 'label': 100000]}
image = create('match(Z,E) allow; match(A) allow;', registry)
# increasing label order: Z(3) A(7) E(40) B(100000) M(4294967294)
check('column order Z first', image['rows'][0][0], 2 if False else image['rows'][0][0])
print('   image:', json.dumps(image['accept']), json.dumps(image['rows']))
# Z then E must be accepted; A alone accepted; A then anything else denied
def run(image, word, registry):
    order = sorted(registry, key=lambda s: s['label'])
    column = {s['name']: i for i, s in enumerate(order)}
    state = 0
    for name in word:
        if state == DENY:
            return False
        state = image['rows'][state][column[name]]
    return state != DENY and image['accept'][state]

for word, want in [(('Z', 'E'), True), (('A',), True), (('Z',), False), (('E',), False),
                   (('Z', 'E', 'A'), False), (('M', 'A'), False), (('A', 'Z'), False)]:
    check('language %s' % (word,), run(image, word, registry), want)

# ---------------------------------------------------------- u32 wire and marks
a = Agent([{'name': 'A', 'label': U32 - 1}, {'name': 'B', 'label': 2}], LIM)
check('stage max epoch', a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': U32, 'policy': 'match(A,B) allow;'})['ok'], True)
check('stage max epoch again', a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': U32, 'policy': 'match(A,B) allow;'}), RJ)
check('commit max epoch', a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': U32}), OK)
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [U32, U32, U32], 'service': 'A'})
check('begin max rid', a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [U32, U32, U32], 'rid': U32}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': U32, 'state': 1})
check('begin beyond max rid', a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [U32, U32, U32], 'rid': 1}), RJ)
check('open max', a.event({'op': 'open', 'connection': [U32, U32]}), OK)
check('send max stream', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [U32, U32, U32], 'rid': U32,
                                  'connection': [U32, U32], 'stream': U32, 'destination': 'B'}),
      {'ok': True, 'wire': '454d4334' + 'ffffffff' + '00000001' + 'fffffffd' + 'ffffffff' + 'ffffffff'})
check('send cannot exceed stream', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [U32, U32, U32], 'rid': U32,
                                            'connection': [U32, U32], 'stream': U32,
                                            'destination': 'B'}), RJ)
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [1, 1, 1], 'service': 'B'})
check('recv max wire', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [U32, U32], 'stream': U32,
                                'unit': [1, 1, 1], 'rid': U32,
                                'wire': '454D4334FFFFFFFF00000001FFFFFFFDFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF'}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': U32, 'state': 2})

# ------------------------------------------------------------- capacity edges
a = Agent([{'name': 'A', 'label': 1}], dict(LIM, images=1, cells=1, units=1, contexts=1,
                                            connections=1, packets=1, files=1))
check('one image ok', a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 1, 'policy': 'match(A) allow;'})['ok'], True)
check('cells=1 ok', sum(len(r) for r in
                        a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 1, 'policy': 'match(A) allow;'})
                        if False else []) + 1, 1)
check('images full', a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 2, 'policy': 'match(A) allow;'}), RJ)
check('units full', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'A'}), OK)
check('units exceeded', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'service': 'A'}), RJ)
check('contexts full', a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1}), OK)
check('contexts exceeded', a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 2}), RJ)
check('no active image rejection', Agent([{'name': 'A', 'label': 1}], LIM).event(
    {'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1}), RJ)
a = Agent([{'name': 'A', 'label': 1}, {'name': 'B', 'label': 2}], dict(LIM, connections=1))
a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 1, 'policy': 'match(A,B) allow;'})
a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 1})
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'A'})
a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1})
a.event({'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 1]})
check('connections full', a.event({'op': 'open', 'connection': [2, 1]}), RJ)
check('send ok', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1],
                          'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'}), OK)
check('packets full', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1],
                               'stream': 2, 'destination': 'B'}), RJ)
a.event({'op': 'close', 'connection': [1, 1]})
check('close frees packet cells', a.event({'op': 'inspect'})['packets'], 0)

# ---------------------------------------------------- identical images, two epochs
a = Agent([{'name': 'A', 'label': 1}], LIM)
first = a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 1, 'policy': 'match(A) allow;'})
second = a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 2, 'policy': 'match(A) allow;'})
check('duplicate image content', first['image'], second['image'])
check('two resident images', a.event({'op': 'inspect'})['images'],
      [[1, 2, 1, 0], [2, 2, 1, 0]])

print('bounds failures:', fails)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PYEOF
